name: knowledge_document
label: Knowledge Document
description: Knowledge documents can be used for time dimension statistical queries and association queries in the knowledge base.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The primary key ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Document source. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: source_idx
indexes.description: Standard index covering the source field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
